python3 -c "
import math

# Device location (San Francisco, CA)
lat1, lon1 = 37.7749, -122.4194

# Shipping address: Boston, MA 02118 (approximate coords)
lat2, lon2 = 42.3388, -71.0685

# Haversine formula
R = 6371  # Earth's radius in km

dlat = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
dlon = math.radians(lon2 - lon1)
a = math.sin(dlat/2)**2 + math.cos(math.radians(lat1)) * math.cos(math.radians(lat2)) * math.sin(dlon/2)**2
c = 2 * math.asin(math.sqrt(a))

dist_km = R * c
dist_mi = dist_km * 0.621371

print(f'=== Distance Estimate ===')
print(f'From: San Francisco, CA (37.7749°N, 122.4194°W)')
print(f'To:   4829 Elm Ridge Way, Suite 7, Boston, MA 02118 (≈42.3388°N, 71.0685°W)')
print(f'')
print(f'Straight-line (great-circle) distance:')
print(f'  {dist_km:,.1f} km')
print(f'  {dist_mi:,.1f} miles')
print(f'')
print(f'Estimated driving distance (typically ~15-30% longer):')
print(f'  ~{dist_mi*1.2:,.0f} – {dist_mi*1.3:,.0f} miles')
